<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions
  xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
  xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
  xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
  xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
  xmlns:semarch="http://semarch.io/schema/1.0"
  id="Definitions_Avionics_PAF_Deliverable"
  targetNamespace="urn:semarch:test:avionics-paf-deliverable-roundtrip">

  <bpmn:dataStore
    id="DataStore_PAF_Deliverable"
    name="PAF Deliverable">
    <bpmn:extensionElements>
      <semarch:SemanticType
        ref="PAF_Deliverable"
        schemaRef="urn:semarch:test:coc-avionics" />
      <semarch:DataProperty
        propertyRef="urn:semarch:test:coc-avionics#PAFDeliverableType.domain"
        schemaRef="urn:semarch:test:coc-avionics"
        value="AIRFRAME" />
      <semarch:DataProperty
        propertyRef="urn:semarch:test:coc-avionics#PAFDeliverableType.isKID"
        schemaRef="urn:semarch:test:coc-avionics"
        value="true" />
      <semarch:DataProperty
        propertyRef="urn:semarch:test:coc-avionics#PAFDeliverableType.isProcessIO"
        schemaRef="urn:semarch:test:coc-avionics"
        value="false" />
      <semarch:DataProperty
        propertyRef="urn:semarch:test:coc-avionics#PAFDeliverableType.template"
        schemaRef="urn:semarch:test:coc-avionics"
        value="TEMPLATE-A" />
    </bpmn:extensionElements>
  </bpmn:dataStore>

  <bpmn:process
    id="Process_Avionics_PAF_Deliverable"
    isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:dataStoreReference
      id="DataStoreReference_PAF_Deliverable_A"
      name="PAF Deliverable A"
      dataStoreRef="DataStore_PAF_Deliverable">
      <bpmn:dataState
        id="DataState_PAF_Deliverable_A"
        name="Test State A" />
    </bpmn:dataStoreReference>

    <bpmn:dataStoreReference
      id="DataStoreReference_PAF_Deliverable_B"
      name="PAF Deliverable B"
      dataStoreRef="DataStore_PAF_Deliverable">
      <bpmn:dataState
        id="DataState_PAF_Deliverable_B"
        name="Test State B" />
    </bpmn:dataStoreReference>

  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram
    id="BPMNDiagram_Avionics_PAF_Deliverable">

    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane
      id="BPMNPlane_Avionics_PAF_Deliverable"
      bpmnElement="Process_Avionics_PAF_Deliverable">

      <bpmndi:BPMNShape
        id="DataStoreReference_PAF_Deliverable_A_di"
        bpmnElement="DataStoreReference_PAF_Deliverable_A">

        <dc:Bounds
          x="220"
          y="160"
          width="50"
          height="50" />

      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <bpmndi:BPMNShape
        id="DataStoreReference_PAF_Deliverable_B_di"
        bpmnElement="DataStoreReference_PAF_Deliverable_B">

        <dc:Bounds
          x="520"
          y="160"
          width="50"
          height="50" />

      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

    </bpmndi:BPMNPlane>

  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>

</bpmn:definitions>

profileSource.name: Avionics Process Profile
profileSource.description: Minimal BPMNSM Avionics profile for the PAF_Deliverable and PAF_Document demonstrator verticals.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xs:schema
  xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema"
  targetNamespace="urn:semarch:test:coc-avionics"
  elementFormDefault="qualified">

  <xs:complexType name="PAFDeliverableType">
    <xs:sequence>
      <xs:element name="domain" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0" />
      <xs:element name="isKID" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0" />
      <xs:element name="isProcessIO" type="xs:boolean" minOccurs="0" />
      <xs:element name="template" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0" />
    </xs:sequence>
  </xs:complexType>

  <xs:complexType name="PAFDocumentType">
    <xs:sequence>
      <xs:element name="URL" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0" />
      <xs:element name="domain" type="xs:string" minOccurs="0" />
    </xs:sequence>
  </xs:complexType>

</xs:schema>
